request:
Create a project named phase_execution_order_test.

Description:
Validates that phases execute sequentially.

Create these phases in order:

Phase 1:
- ID: phase_foundation
- Title: Foundation

Phase 2:
- ID: phase_delivery
- Title: Delivery

Create these tasks:

1. ID: task_foundation_create
   Title: Create foundation marker
   Phase: phase_foundation
   Command: cmd /c echo foundation > C:\Users\Owner\nova\phase_foundation_marker.txt

2. ID: task_foundation_verify
   Title: Verify foundation marker
   Phase: phase_foundation
   Depends on: task_foundation_create
   Command: cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Owner\nova\phase_foundation_marker.txt (exit 0) else (exit 1)

3. ID: task_delivery_create
   Title: Create delivery marker
   Phase: phase_delivery
   Command: cmd /c echo delivery > C:\Users\Owner\nova\phase_delivery_marker.txt

4. ID: task_delivery_verify
   Title: Verify delivery marker
   Phase: phase_delivery
   Depends on: task_delivery_create
   Command: cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Owner\nova\phase_delivery_marker.txt (exit 0) else (exit 1)

The project must execute phases sequentially:
- Complete all eligible tasks in phase_foundation before phase_delivery begins.
- Respect task dependencies.
- Do not execute delivery tasks before foundation tasks are complete.
